thread:
sam-support: FYI customers A/B/C reporting 5xx + timeouts to /v1/generate since ~09:30 UTC. Opening postmortem thread for root cause + comms.

maya-sre: Oncall is looking. early signs point to auth proxy errors and a routing fallback misconfig that caused retry storms.

ben-oncall: I’ve paused the canary rollout for auth-proxy v2 and added stricter circuit breakers (429 after 3 failed attempts).

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: auth-proxy service canary v2 -> v1 (canary-id: c-1122). ETA ~4m.

alice-eng: Noted. Can we route traffic to dedicated fallback model (gpt-small-quant) to reduce backend pressure while we stabilize?
\
drew-rl: Yes — added temporary routing rule to route 25% -> gpt-small-quant, 75% -> primary. Will monitor latency.

sam-support: Sent interim comms to impacted customers: "We're investigating increased 5xx/timeouts; temporary mitigation in progress; updates in 30m."

zach-product: Need a clear postmortem checklist for customers: timeline, root cause, action items, ETA for full fix, and compensation ask.

maya-sre: Repro steps captured: 
1) curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' 
2) observe 502/504 + auth-proxy logs: \"rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection lost\"

ops-bot: Log sample uploaded: https://internal.ops/logs/1757654321/ (permission required).

alice-eng: Found correlation: spikes in auth-token refresh failures to KMS at 09:29:12 UTC. KMS latencies increased ~3x and caused auth-proxy token verification timeouts which cascaded to gateway queue saturation.

ben-oncall: KMS team says there was a regional network blip; they restored full perf at 09:40 UTC. Rolling back canary + circuit breakers held, so 5xx decreased after 09:45.

sam-support: Timeline draft: 
- 09:28 UTC: KMS regional latency spike starts
- 09:30 UTC: auth-proxy token validation errors rise -> gateway retries -> queue saturation
- 09:33 UTC: customers begin reporting 5xx/timeouts
- 09:35 UTC: canary auth-proxy v2 sees increased errors, amplifies retries
- 09:38 UTC: oncall paused canary, circuit breaker enabled, route adjustments made
- 09:45 UTC: KMS restored, errors decline
- 09:50 UTC: rollback complete, traffic stable

drew-rl: Action items (owner / due): 
- Add circuit-breaker thresholds per-region, default 3s auth timeout (maya-sre / 3d)
- Add token-cache fallback in auth-proxy to avoid KMS trips (alice-eng / 2w)
- Improve retry budget logic to avoid thundering herd (ben-oncall / 1w)
- Customer comms + compensation template (zach-product / 2d)
- Add synthetic KMS latency tests into canary gating (eng-infra / 1w)

maya-sre: I’ll open the infra ticket for region-level circuit-breaker config and add to oncall runbook.

sam-support: Please assign a primary owner for the postmortem doc and get it into the weekly incident review.

zach-product: I’ll own the customer-facing postmortem. Draft due EOD tomorrow.

alice-eng: I’ll prototype a short-lived token-cache that serves last-known-good tokens when KMS timings exceed threshold. Will circle back with a design doc.

ben-oncall: Follow-up: enable enhanced tracing for /v1/generate so we can capture auth timing breakdowns without PII. (ben-oncall / today)

deploy-bot: canary rollback completed (canary-id: c-1122). No active canaries for auth-proxy.

ops-bot: Metric snapshots attached: 5xx rate (09:20-10:00), auth latency heatmap, queue depth graphs.

sam-support: Good, next steps: 1) finalize timeline & RCA, 2) publish customer postmortem draft, 3) implement circuit-breaker config, 4) track token-cache prototype.

drew-rl: Adding one more item: update default client SDK to respect Retry-After headers to help downstream clients avoid exacerbating retries (alice-eng / 2w).

maya-sre: Marking this thread as blockable for followups. Will create JIRA EPIC for infra + runtime fixes.

sam-support: Thanks all — please add any missed items. I’ll update customers after the draft is ready. :thumbsup:
